title: IdentityEvent
description: The payload of every actor and token event (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"): <transition>/v1, e.g. actor.created/v1 or token.revoked/v1. Each carries its record as it is after the transition, so a projection is the latest record and a rebuild is a fold. The event's subject is the actor (actor.*) or the token (token.*). internal/identity checks every transition against the current record in the writer transaction.
